_what_this_is: Names that differ between base avatars. Copy to gates_config.json and fill in YOUR base's names (open the purchased .blend/.fbx and read them off the outliner). Keys starting with _ are comments.
_body_mesh: The mesh the body edit is applied to; it carries the body shape keys.
_face_mesh: The head/face mesh. It sits inside the head by design and is excluded from garment-fit counting and from conversion. Set to "" if the face is part of the body mesh.
_guard_property: The custom property your converter sets on the outfit armature when a file has been converted. Note: FBX export drops custom properties, so this alone cannot detect an already-converted outfit after a round trip; your converter needs a second check (the spec, section 3.4).
_humanoid_bones: Role -> bone name on this base. poses.json refers to roles, not names, so one pose file works on any base. If a role is missing here and a pose needs it, the fit gate stops with an error instead of silently measuring the rest pose.
_expected_body_key_groups: Body shape keys that outfits may expect to be ON (the base's 'squeeze under a sock band' or 'shrink the body under clothing' keys). Smallest group first. When a garment penetrates, the fit gate retries with each group on and reports which group explains it. Match rules: contains / startswith / exact, case-insensitive except exact. Read your base's key list and adjust.
_mixture_keys: For the preservation audit's key-mixture check: either "auto" (the eight keys with the largest effect, each at 0.5) or an explicit map {"KeyName": 0.8, ...}. An empty selection is an error, not a pass.
